Senses.PreferredTarget: walk on the deepest ocean floor
AlternateTargets: go at the very bottom of the sea
Senses.Explanation: Literally, “walk at the deep-deep bottom of the sea.” In 205 occurrences across 116 allowlisted texts, it overwhelmingly forms the second half of the paired formula “stand on the highest peak; walk on the deepest ocean floor” (高高峰頂立，深深海底行). The pair is spoken as advice, posed as a public question—“how do you understand it?” (汝作麼生會)—and reused in later appraisal and comment. One record pairs two people, “one stands on the high-high mountaintop; one walks at the deep-deep bottom of the sea” (一人高高山頂立，一人深深海底行); another expands the parallel with “one sails a boat on the mountain; one races a horse before the cliff” (一個山上行船，一個巖前走馬). Yuanwu answers the quoted pair with “a staff strikes a stone man’s head” (棒打石人頭). The phrase’s Chan deviation is this stable, publicly tested two-line formula, not an ordinary report of underwater travel.
Senses.Note: The mountain and sea halves are one paired formula, not separate senses. Different replies to the same interview line are readings or responses, not different referents.

Occurrences.Kwic: 太守欲得保任此事。直須向高高山頂立。深深海底行。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元): in the encounter with governor Li Ao, Yaoshan Weiyan tells the governor that to preserve this matter he must stand on the highest mountain peak and walk on the deepest sea floor.

Occurrences.Kwic: 高高峰頂立，深深海底行。汝作麼生會？師于言下頓悟曰：釘殺脚跟也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Complete Book of the Five Lamps, volumes 34–120 (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)): in Zhengjue Zongxian's biography, Zhaojue Chunbai is the exact teacher marked 覺 who asks Zongxian how he understands standing on the highest peak and walking on the deepest sea floor; Zongxian awakens at the words.

Occurrences.Kwic: 高高峯頂立。深深海底行。師云。棒打石人頭。
一人高高山頂立，一人深深海底行，各自隨方而來，同會九重城裏。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Huayan Jue, who opens his hall address with the paired lines about standing on the solitary summit and walking on the deepest sea floor.

Occurrences.Kwic: 一個在高高峰頂立，一個在深深海底行，一個山上行船，一個巖前走馬
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Collected Old Cases Raised in the Lineage (宗門拈古彙集), Deshan Xuanjian section. Yuan Mingyu, introduced inline as Yu'an Yu (愚菴盂), is the exact later commentator who contrasts one standing atop the high peak with one walking at the deep ocean floor; Yuan Mingyu is not yet in the roster.
